clue.text: Make a futile attempt to sell Shergar?

parts.note: to flog is informal British for to sell
Shergar, a famous Derby-winning racehorse, was kidnapped in Ireland in 1983 and presumed killed

explanation.surface: Someone vainly tries to sell a famous stolen racehorse.
explanation.walkthrough: Shergar was never found, so he is taken to be a dead horse; selling him is flogging one.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means wasting effort on a cause already lost, just as beating a dead animal will never make it run.

clue.text: USA oil in a distilled state

indicators.note: distilling breaks a liquid down and reforms it, so the preceding letters are reworked

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: American crude oil refined in some state of the union.
explanation.walkthrough: Louisiana is itself an oil-producing US state, which makes the surface neat.
explanation.definitionFit: Louisiana is one of the fifty constituent states of the United States, on the Gulf of Mexico.

clue.text: Good lines to speak in a surly way

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for good
two lines: a row, and L, the abbreviation for line

explanation.surface: Delivering one's lines well while sounding grumpy.
explanation.definitionFit: To growl is to utter words in a low, angry, bad-tempered voice like a dog snarling.

clue.text: Head of department's language books replaced by Dutch criminal

indicators.note: one piece is swapped out of the word and another put in its place
the head of a word is its opening letter, so only that one is kept

parts.note: first letter of department
the invented international language
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books
D is the abbreviation for Dutch

explanation.surface: A department head's language textbooks swapped for a Dutch crook.
explanation.walkthrough: The language is the invented international one; the New Testament stands for books, and Dutch swaps in for them.
explanation.definitionFit: A desperado is a reckless outlaw, typically a bandit of the American Wild West, so a criminal.

clue.text: Designed top holiday location

parts.note: A1, first-class, written with the letter I for the one
the Med, the Mediterranean, a favourite holiday spot

explanation.surface: An ideal holiday resort that someone has planned.
explanation.walkthrough: Crosswords often write A1 (excellent) as AI.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean intended or meant, as in a remark designed or aimed to hurt.

clue.text: Start to swear briefly after lout becomes mischievous creature

indicators.note: cut short, so the last letter of the word for swear is dropped

parts.note: a hob is an old word for a rustic clown or lout
go means start, as in 'ready, steady, go'
from 'effing and blinding', swearing

explanation.surface: A yob starts cursing and turns into an imp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After lout' puts HOB at the front; 'effing and blinding' is British slang for swearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A hobgoblin is a small, ugly, mischievous sprite or imp from English folklore.

clue.text: Leading ladies standing up for chief magistrate

indicators.note: in a down entry, standing up means the letters run from bottom to top

parts.note: Eve, the first woman, and ER, Elizabeth Regina, the queen

explanation.surface: Star actresses rising to honour a top judge.
explanation.walkthrough: Eve leads as the first lady in Genesis and ER as queen leads the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: A reeve was the chief officer of a town or district in Anglo-Saxon England, a local magistrate.

clue.text: Body part found by detective on beat

parts.note: a private eye is a detective
to lash is to beat or whip

explanation.surface: A police officer on patrol discovers a piece of a corpse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beat' suggests a police patrol round, but it is a verb meaning whip.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyelash is one of the hairs on the eyelid, a small part of the human body.

clue.text: Talks of special vegetables containing potassium

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for special

indicators.note: the vegetables hold the element symbol inside them

parts.note: peas are vegetables
K is the chemical symbol for potassium

explanation.surface: Discussions of particular greens rich in potassium.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are present-tense verbs for saying words aloud in conversation, interchangeable in 'she talks'.

clue.text: Middle-eastern group welcomes Utah's underworld leader

indicators.note: to welcome is to take in, so the group holds the state abbreviation

parts.note: the Palestine Liberation Organisation
UT is the postal abbreviation for Utah

explanation.surface: A Middle Eastern organisation hosts a Mormon chief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Underworld leader' suggests a crime boss but means the god of the dead.
explanation.definitionFit: In Roman myth Pluto is the god who rules Hades, the realm of the dead beneath the earth.

clue.text: Note of thirteenth letter in riddle cracked by Britain

indicators.note: the spelled-out letter goes inside the riddle word
a thing cracked is split open and something forced into the gap

parts.note: a riddle is a coarse sieve, and to riddle is to sift
the thirteenth letter of the alphabet, spelt out
BR is an abbreviation for Britain

explanation.surface: A puzzle about the letter M solved by a British team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Riddle' looks like a puzzle but is a garden sieve, the thing used to riddle soil; the letter goes in first, then Britain splits it again.
explanation.definitionFit: A semibreve is the musical note lasting four crotchet beats, called a whole note in American usage.

clue.text: Alberta's note against European remit

parts.note: AB is the abbreviation for the Canadian province of Alberta
sol, the fifth note of the sol-fa scale
V for versus
E is the abbreviation for European

explanation.surface: A Canadian province's memo opposing a European brief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Remit' looks like a noun meaning brief, but it is the verb meaning forgive.
explanation.definitionFit: To remit sins is to pardon them, and to absolve is likewise to free someone from guilt or blame.

clue.text: Couple study American food processors

parts.note: a duo is a pair
a den is a private study room
A is the abbreviation for American

explanation.surface: Two people researching American kitchen appliances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Food processors' looks like kitchen gadgets, but these process food inside the body.
explanation.definitionFit: The duodenum is the first section of the small intestine, where digestion breaks down eaten matter; DUODENA is its plural.

clue.text: Sting's technologically advanced, witty and stylish

definitions.meaning: verb: to hurt with a sharp pain
as in a phone or bomb with built-in computing
clever and quick, as in a sharp remark

explanation.surface: A tribute to the singer Sting as high-tech, funny and well dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital makes Sting look like the rock star; it is the verb, one of four separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers a stinging pain, computerised devices, clever repartee and neat smart clothing.

clue.text: Conductor's to make an electronic copy of single

parts.note: to scan in is to digitise a document
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An orchestral conductor digitising a hit record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Single' suggests a pop record but stands for the numeral one.
explanation.definitionFit: Arturo Toscanini was a celebrated Italian orchestral conductor who led the NBC Symphony Orchestra.

clue.text: Flies hang around shark

indicators.note: letters moved around are put into a fresh order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Insects hovering near a predatory fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The angel shark, a flat-bodied bottom-dwelling shark, is also commonly called the angelfish.

clue.text: Bargee and tar sailing around large Canadian Lake

indicators.note: craft sailing around move about freely, so the letters are scrambled

parts.note: the two words, without the joining and

explanation.surface: A canal boatman and a sailor cruise round a big Canadian lake.
explanation.walkthrough: A bargee works a canal barge and a tar is a sailor; both lose their letters to the scramble.
explanation.definitionFit: Great Bear Lake in Canada's Northwest Territories is the largest lake lying wholly within Canada.

clue.text: End a healing process

definitions.meaning: first meaning: an aim or purpose
second meaning: in medicine, the way a wound closes

explanation.walkthrough: 'End' looks like a finish but means a goal; the medical sense is how a wound's edges knit together.
explanation.definitionFit: An intention is an aim or goal, and surgeons describe wounds as healing by first or second intention.

clue.text: French chalk adding quality to Palmolive and Lux?

parts.note: Palmolive and Lux are brands of soap; the question mark marks them as examples
tone is the character or quality of a sound or style

explanation.surface: A talc additive improving two branded soaps.
explanation.walkthrough: French chalk is a form of talc used by tailors to mark cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Soapstone, or steatite, is a soft talc rock, and French chalk is finely ground soapstone or talc.

clue.text: Pig eating young fish and bird

indicators.note: whatever eats something takes it inside itself

parts.note: a sow is a female pig
a parr is a young salmon

explanation.surface: A farm animal swallowing a small fish and a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The sparrow is a small brown perching bird, common in towns and gardens worldwide.

clue.text: Disconcertingly holds back gunpowder component

indicators.note: read back, so from right to left
the long word holds the answer within its letters

parts.note: letters inside the adverb

explanation.surface: Someone unsettlingly withholding part of the explosive mix.
explanation.definitionFit: Nitre, or saltpetre (potassium nitrate), is the oxidising ingredient of traditional black gunpowder.

clue.text: What a choir may do under running water is relaxing

indicators.note: in a down entry, putting one piece under another sends the choir's activity to the bottom, second

parts.note: ea is a dialect word for a river or stream
choirs sing

explanation.surface: Choral singing beneath a flowing stream is soothing.
explanation.walkthrough: Ea is an old dialect word for a river, a crossword favourite for running water.
explanation.definitionFit: Easing means loosening or slackening, so lessening tension, as when relaxing a grip.

clue.text: A republican bum's liabilities

parts.note: taken as written
R is the abbreviation for Republican
rear's, a bum being a backside

explanation.surface: A Republican layabout's debts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bum' suggests a vagrant, but here it is the bottom; the apostrophe is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: Arrears are overdue debts or payments still owed, so financial obligations or liabilities.

clue.text: Develop paper in, for example, reading and writing

indicators.note: the newspaper is placed inside the other pieces

parts.note: reading is one of the three Rs
the i is a British newspaper, sister to the Independent
to pen is to write

explanation.surface: Developing a dissertation on literacy skills.
explanation.walkthrough: The three Rs are reading, writing and arithmetic.
explanation.definitionFit: To ripen is to mature or grow fully, as fruit does, so to develop.

clue.text: Horse also includes other animals

indicators.note: the phrase includes the answer within its run of letters

parts.note: letters spanning the two words

explanation.surface: A stable that keeps more than horses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Other animals' means animals other than the horse just mentioned.
explanation.definitionFit: Seals are marine mammals, a different kind of creature from the horse named at the start.

clue.text: Spanish man returns on Thursday with toilets

parts.note: TH is the abbreviation for Thursday

indicators.note: returning means going back the way it came, right to left

parts.note: señor is Spanish for man or gentleman

explanation.surface: A Spaniard comes back on Thursday to fit lavatories.
explanation.definitionFit: The throne is humorous slang for the lavatory seat, so thrones are toilets.

clue.text: Domain of artistic movement one's abandoned

parts.note: realism, the movement in art depicting life as it is
I (one) plus 's

clue.text: Make another pie cooked with claret

indicators.note: something cooked has been worked over and transformed into a new form

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Baking a second pie flavoured with red wine.

clue.text: One with legal right to make film

parts.note: a, as in one
a lien is a right to hold property until a debt is paid

explanation.surface: Someone holding the rights needed to shoot a movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Alien is Ridley Scott's 1979 science-fiction horror film about a monster aboard a spaceship.

clue.text: Maybe brass anemometer?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a musical instrument played by blowing, brass being one family
second meaning, read literally: a device that measures breezes

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful second reading: an anemometer measures the speed of moving air.
explanation.definitionFit: Trumpets and horns are blown musical devices, while an anemometer is a scientific gauge for air currents.
